scenes.bubble: The auditors will count the stock, won't they?
scenes.caption: Year‑end stock counts.
scenes.say: Myth or fact? The year-end stock count is the auditor's job.
cap: The year‑end *stock count* is the auditor's job.

scenes.head: Management counts. Auditors observe.
scenes.src: Illustrative example, not a real company. Our view; arrangements differ by auditor. Valorin is not an audit firm.
scenes.say: Usually not. Management plans and runs the count, with its own staff. Auditors typically attend to observe and test it.
cap: *Management* plans and runs the count, with its own staff.
Auditors typically attend to *observe and test* it.

scenes.say: Plan instructions and cut-off, record every item, then reconcile the count to the system.
cap: Plan instructions and cut‑off, record every item, then *reconcile* the count to the system.

scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Valorin is not an audit firm; audit readiness support only.
scenes.say: Our audit readiness support covers count planning. Count day coming up? Send us a WhatsApp before the count.
cap: Our audit readiness support covers count planning.
Send us a *WhatsApp* before the count.
